C-5_vercel_api_reproducibility.context: v1.0.1 VERCEL_MEASUREMENT.method did not record the exact invocation needed to reproduce the read on this platform.

C-5_vercel_api_reproducibility.corrected_method_string: MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 vercel api "/v9/projects/uellix-antigravity/env" --raw, parsed through a field allowlist {key,type,target,gitBranch,updatedAt}, no decrypt. Authenticated as lorenzozanello-5040. Without MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 the same command fails to reach the API at all, which would be silently indistinguishable from 'no such endpoint' rather than a shell artifact.
